title: STNFS v9 for recover-P: measured line-path table, wide-prime kernels and a freshly judged region on v8: 119.889929619243

claims.statement: For the full production bls12-381-fixed-g2-invert-g1 target, the complete STNFS algorithm of proof.md, DESCENT.md and STORAGE.md returns P with e(P,Q)=z for the exact supplied nonidentity Q (P=[a]P0 from two GT logarithms, g=e(P0,Q); z=1 handled directly) with success at least 0.39 over uniform challenges and fresh coins under the disclosed heuristics H1-H5, and all classical work is bounded by a global meter at 2^119.889929619243 dense-Fp12 units (C=20,000 instructions); upper-rounded ledger rows sum to 2^119.889929619242911. Relation collection (v8's sieve, box-shared certified norm bounds, band strip and f-first early abort; v9 prices the line path at the public slice12 line walk measured on random (p, s) pairs by points per coset h (table (18.81, 17.2), (13.82, 24.1), (9.82, 38.99), (5.82, 88.32), (1.83, 352.1) Ir per update, each entry at least the larger of the single-pair base point and the pooled cost plus 2 SE of the random-pair group at or below its h; cap 17.2 for h >= 2^18.81), and primes in [2^63, 2^64) on the measured wide12.c path (record table of the public slice12 x 1.01, setup6w, wide lattices a 2^70.6 row)): excess 1.05, theta=2326/8000 sized on pool B (seeds 7-10) and judged once on a fresh pool D (seeds 41-44, 656,000 draws; pre-registered rule), retained relations >= 2^63.6016 (0.0798 bits above 1.05 U, pool SE 0.0177), 99.9% ECM, X2=2^64, slacks (295, 226), work priced on pools B, C, D with v8's allowance 1.0174 kept as a floor: <= 2^119.444013904 units. Linear algebra: filtering re-measured at excess 1.05 (64 runs, 2^12..2^18), N/U 0.06617 at 2^17 x pad 1.116 (every maximum from 2^15 up) x weight-300 ratio 0.732 (maximum over every scale): N = 2^59.2420 < 10 x 2^56 (ten owners, row tail counted 1,638, charged 1,650); unit share charged 0.87 (below every measured value), Krylov 13.21 and Horner 20.9 per entry, 97 per dense term, 420 per reduction, 60 per projection term, blocks (28, 5): <= 2^117.925074783 units; generator <= 2^108.288165823. Descent (v7 plan, sub-bin yields, lazy evaluation) at the judged pool's inputs (relations 63.566 = estimate minus 2 SE, mean norms 740.8/499.4): expected two-log work <= 2^112.4402; meter 2^113.156048; Markov abort <= 0.6088472; boot failure 1.475e-05 per log, expected nodes 2^15.70, node abort 2^-11.60, repeats 2^-10.70, 2/r charged. Preprocessing, failures, transfers, verification and output are included; nothing amortized; memory at most 2^105 bytes. Analytic exploratory claim, not a full-size run.

experiments.purpose: Bounded audit of recorded full-recurrence evidence, upward-rounded ledger and success, unchanged prime-window endpoints, nonzero lower/upper integration controls, and the lazy-cofactorisation bound against a simulation. Does not rerun the full recurrence.

Rerun the package's filtering simulation (filtsim.py) at relation excess 1.05 (default; optional 'excess') and pool D's mean norms to mean weight 100, 200 or 300 (default 300) and report the fraction of row weight carried by +-1 entries (against the charged 0.87) and U/N. Optional (the hosted initial run is the bounded audit). Evidence at its scale only; production is extrapolated (H4u, H3).

Optional full recomputation of certificates, pools (replay of a block of judged-pool draws, region sums of pools B, C, D, the sizing rule), box bounds, region, ledger (v9 line table and wide-prime path against the shipped callgrind logs, early abort, weight-300 LA with five-vector Krylov kernels, ten-owner row tail), retention, ECM, lazy descent (with a simulation) and declared bounds (about 1.5 minutes natively).
